**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no employee non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant of any kind:

- Full-text searches for "solicit", "induce", "hire" and "employ" surface no restrictive covenant on hiring or recruiting.
- AbbVie's only covenant (Section 10.4.1) is an IP/confidentiality flow-down from its personnel, not a restriction on hiring.
- Article 13 (Miscellaneous), a likely home for such a covenant, contains only force majeure and Harpoon change-of-control notice.
- Section 6.15 (No Other Compensation) is the closest employee-facing provision, but it is a no-side-payments representation, not a solicitation restriction.

This matches the playbook's **preferred** position — no non-solicit binding the customer — so nothing needs to be changed.
